extracted.intended_audience: U.S. patent examiners, patent prosecution attorneys, and applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Chapter index of MPEP 1300 outlining the topics, procedural requirements, and standards governing allowance and issuance of U.S. patents. Used by examiners and practitioners to locate rules on preparing applications for allowance, notices of allowance, issue fees, withdrawals, and related matters.
